newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 4.831 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 4.831 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 4.831 million lbs of frozen ground beef for reprocessing for use in the National School Lunch and other Federal food assistance programs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-52 and be received by 1430 EST in Washington, D.C., on Friday, August 1. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, August 8.
Shipments must be made between September 7 and 20, 1997.
